sbh4.1:1.14: Printed *dṛṣṭisthiraḥ* (the MS has *dṛṣṭi*); read *dṛḍhaḥ sthiraḥ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 4).
sbh4.1:3.5: Printed *samāpattyupapattikleśāntatāṁ*, so the MS; read *sasamāpattyupapattike śāntatāṁ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, nn. 18–19).
sbh4.1:5.7: Printed *artha, svalakṣaṇaṁ, sāmānyalakṣaṇaṁ*, Shukla's conjecture; read *artham, vastu, lakṣaṇam* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 29).
sbh4.1:7.2: Printed text omits *kāmeṣu kāmacchandaḥ, asti bahirdhā*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 30).
sbh4.1:8.9: Printed *pratyasta-* (the MS has *pravyaṣṭa-*); read *praduṣṭa-* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 35).
sbh4.1:10.11: Printed text (Shukla) restored where the transcription dropped it. 'As before': the troubles of seeking, sbh1.3:37.30–39.29.
sbh4.1:10.19: Printed *viṣayagāminaḥ*, so the MS; read *vilayagāminaḥ* with the Abhiprāyikārthagāthā v. 45, Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 50). Printed *pratyayādhipā*; read *pratyayādhīnāḥ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 51).
sbh4.1:10.22: Printed *māramārabhyaiṣa*, Shukla's conjecture; read *mārasyaiṣa* (MS *māmārasyaiṣa*, with dittography, per Deleanu 2006, n. 54).
sbh4.1:11.1: Printed text and the MS lack the question; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 60). Printed *anityaṁ*, so the MS; read *nityaṁ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 61). Printed *nityakālaṁ(ma)dhruvaṁ*; read *dhruvaṁ*, without Shukla's bracketed *a-* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 61).
sbh4.1:12.15: Printed *grastena evāturena*; read *grastena ivāturena* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 75).
sbh4.1:13.2: Printed text omits *anenaudārikatvena virahitāc … kāmeṣv* by haplography; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, nn. 84–87; he reads *virahitatvāc*).
sbh4.1:14.3: Printed *yathā yathā tām*; read *yathāparyeṣitām* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 93).
sbh4.1:17.3: Printed text omits *na* before *pratisaṁvedayāmi*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 106).
sbh4.1:17.7: Printed *sevanāprābhāraṁ nāpekṣāpattiyutena nirvijugupsāprati vā niḥpratikūlatā*; read *sevanāprāgbhāraṁ nopekṣā santiṣṭhate, na nirvit, jugupsā, prativāṇiḥ, pratikūlatā* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 107–111; *santiṣṭhate* and *nirvit* are his emendations).
sbh4.1:17.10: Printed *dharmatābhinigṛhītaṁ*, so the MS and Tibetan; read *na dharmatābhinigṛhītam* with Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 112).
sbh4.1:18.8: Printed *prayogadhyānaprayogamārga-*, so the MS; read *prathamadhyānaprayogamārga-* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 119).
sbh4.1:20.2: Printed *kadācit kenacit* and *prāyoganiṣṭhāmanaskārakālasyāratiḥ*; read *kadācit kadācit* and *prayoganiṣṭhāmanaskārakāle spharati* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 124, 126).
sbh4.1:20.3: Printed *dhyānavipulatara-* and *asyāsya*; read *ghanavipulatara-* and *asphuṭaṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 127, 129).
sbh4.1:20.5: Printed text omits *mārga* after *pratipakṣa*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 136).
sbh4.1:21.2: Printed *prajānāti*; read *parijānāti* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 138). Printed text omits *yat prāptavyaṁ tad api samyak prajānāti*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 140).
sbh4.1:21.5: Printed *adhimātrajñaśāntāṁ*; read *adhimātrān kleśān* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 141–142).
sbh4.1:21.9: Printed *kleśaprakārāṇāṁ*, so the MS; read *manaskāraprakārāṇāṁ* with Tibetan, Xuanzang and the Abhidharmasamuccayabhāṣya (Tatia ed., p. 80) (Deleanu 2006, n. 145).
sbh4.1:22.3: Printed *'pi dūṣaṇā-*; read *vidūṣaṇā-* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 147).
sbh4.1:22.10: Printed *pravighnā*; read *praviṣṭā* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 151). The six are the attentions named at 22.1–22.8, without the fruit-of-practice-culmination attention.
sbh4.1:24.7: Printed *vihāraḥ*; read *vicāraḥ*, 'examination', the term kept in Sanskrit elsewhere (Deleanu 2006, ed. p. 328; cf. 24.8).
sbh4.1:24.13: Printed *ākāyikās*, restored where the transcription dropped the first syllable; the MS has *akāyikās*; read *āyāpāyikāḥ* with Tibetan, Xuanzang and the same series at Shukla p. 424 (Deleanu 2006, n. 169).
sbh4.1:24.16: Printed *prītisukham evānuśaṁsānugatāḥ*, so the MS; read *prītisukhaleśānuśaṁsānugatāḥ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 170).
